authority_basis.summary: Record the exact generic logarithmic weight-page profiles for the seven-mark four-site terms.

operations.title: The seven-mark four-site weight page has three source profiles
operations.body: After geometric deduplication with occurrence simplices retained, the 28 source terms have three generic logarithmic E1 profiles: (5 marks,0 smooth,5 nodal; W4/W5/W6=15/20/20)x4, (5,1,4;19/20/20)x4, and (6,1,5;22/30/40)x20, all with W3=20.

operations.title: Seven-mark geometric deduplication and weight-page census
operations.body: The checker reconstructs exact marked normals, groups coincident occurrences, applies the E7/A1^3 surface types, and counts generic elliptic pair and deck-point triple layers termwise.

operations.title: Benincasa freezes the seven-mark four-site weight-page profiles
operations.body: Entry 1186 freezes the generic seven-mark logarithmic E1 page. Three source profiles occur: W3=20 universally; W4/W5/W6 are 15/20/20 (4 terms), 19/20/20 (4), or 22/30/40 (20). The only generic coefficient types are quartic-double-solid middle, Tate E7/A1^3 surfaces, elliptic pair H1, and deck-Tate triple points. These are E1 budgets, not final cohomology. Next is the actual first restriction/Gysin differential on one representative per profile.
